verified.exploit_entry_point: The settings API write (POST /api/set_config_value and its legacy alias), reached with the account's own Basic credentials through the product's Flask blueprint. The account holds SETTINGS (128) and ADD (1), never ADMIN.
sites: src/pyload/core/managers/thread_manager.py:157-199 (the stored program is executed by subprocess.run)
routes: the reported route only: a non-admin with SETTINGS changes the reconnection program
verified.services: None: offline and local; an in-process core driven through its Flask test client.
verified.project_tests_run: tests/test_skeleton.py and tests/test_mega_nz_folder.py (3 tests) pass on the pinned tree and under the reference fix; copied into tests/pristine and run in the functional group.

traps.shape: the settings write is gated only by the settings permission, so a non-administrator stores the program the reconnection path runs
